title: HOLD-LC-001 public raw-product availability boundary
question: Do the official GWOSC, LIGO and Fermi pages establish discoverable raw or posterior products for HOLD-LC-001, and can that availability be recorded without treating it as a source-owned timing likelihood or changing the existing T-054/T-059 methods?
method: Read the existing HOLD-LC-001 source packet and set-valued envelope as the controlling local estimand versions.
Check the official GWOSC event page, LIGO P1800061 data page and Fermi GBM product documentation as public-product locators.
Separate raw strain, posterior samples, TTE and detector-response products from the joint timing likelihood/covariance required by the inverse contract.

Register a new acquisition contract with exact bytes, calibration, time standard, nuisance, covariance and F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs requirements, without scoring candidates or changing any issued method authority.
Apply hostile checks for posterior double-counting, target leakage, raw-product substitution and method overhaul.
finding: The official pages make public raw or derived products discoverable: GWOSC exposes GW170817 strain/event products, LIGO P1800061 exposes posterior-sample release material, and Fermi GBM documents burst TTE and detector-response products. This confirms an actionable acquisition path, but none of those discovery pages supplies a locally hash-pinned source-owned joint timing likelihood or component covariance for the current packet. The new boundary therefore advances source intake without scoring, without converting raw products into a likelihood, and without changing T-054 or T-059.
decision_reason: This is a bounded additive P1 input advance rather than another blocked revalidation: it distinguishes discoverable raw products from the missing statistical object and fixes the exact fields a future estimator must freeze. Existing forward and inverse methods, estimands, owner order and promotion firewalls remain controlling.
boundary: T0 public-product discovery and estimator-acquisition contract only. It supplies no likelihood, covariance, candidate map, score, prospective validation, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum, physical-empty sign or mass-gap result.

products: GWOSC public strain and event products
Fermi GBM burst TTE and detector-response product documentation
exact_scope.local_status: No event-specific bytes are downloaded or hash-frozen by this record.
exact_scope.statistical_status: No joint timing likelihood, component covariance or intrinsic-lag probability law is admitted.
exact_scope.method_status: T-054 forward method and T-059 inverse method remain unchanged.

checks.detail: The three official locators are recorded with product roles and an explicit no-local-bytes status.
Raw or posterior products are not substituted for the missing source-owned joint timing likelihood/covariance.
HOLD-LC-001 remains retrospective and receives no prospective credit or candidate score.
No existing method, estimator, owner order, result or gate is edited; only a new input-availability packet is added.

adversarial_review.check: Public strain/TTE availability does not create the source-owned timing likelihood or covariance required by T-059.
Posterior samples are not used as an independent timing datum beside the existing source summary.
The holdout remains retrospective and no parameter, map or scorer is tuned from it.
The record adds a source-intake pointer only; T-054, T-059, R-192 order and existing estimands are unchanged.

assumptions: The official URLs are valid discovery locators on 2026-08-30.
Public product availability is distinct from local hash freeze and statistical admission.
Any future estimator will be a new versioned candidate-neutral package and will not rewrite the current HOLD-LC-001 packet.
Existing T-054 and T-059 authorities remain controlling if a future acquisition proposal conflicts with them.
missing_assumptions: Calibration, time-standard, background and selection metadata.
Joint timing likelihood or covariance with component correlations.
Intrinsic-emission nuisance law or an explicitly retained set-valued alternative.
Complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map and immutable scorer.
next_action: Pursue a separately versioned raw-product estimator only after its bytes, calibration, timing windows, covariance/likelihood, nuisance law, map stages and scorer are frozen; otherwise keep HOLD-LC-001 feasibility-only and continue the unchanged T-054 owner intake.
